name: Fresh Calendars News Desk
bio: The Fresh Calendars News Desk is the editorial team behind Fresh Calendars News. It publishes the daily puzzle pages, with graded hints and a clearly marked answer section for games such as Wordle, NYT Connections, Strands and Contexto, under the same editorial policy as every other story. The desk also handles reader tips and correction reports, works with the editors who cover holidays, school calendars, time changes and seasonal events, and notes each correction at the end of the article with the date it was made.
